
            <h1 class="postTitle">
                <a id="cb_post_title_url" class="postTitle2 vertical-middle" href="https://www.cnblogs.com/xiaoyan2017/p/19088804" title="发布于 2025-09-13 08:21">
    <span role="heading" aria-level="2">Electron38-Wechat电脑端聊天|vite7+electron38仿微信桌面端聊天系统</span>
    

</a>

            </h1>
            <div class="clear"></div>
            <div class="postBody">
                <div id="cnblogs_post_body" class="blogpost-body blogpost-body-html">
<p><span style="font-size: 18px; font-family: 宋体, &quot;Songti SC&quot;; color: rgba(7, 193, 96, 1)">最新研发<span style="background-color: rgba(255, 255, 153, 1)">Electron38+Vite7+Pinia3</span>客户端仿微信聊天系统<em>ElectronWinChat</em>。</span></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><strong>electron38-vue3-wechat</strong>基于<span style="background-color: rgba(252, 217, 196, 1)">vite7.1+electron38+pinia3+element-plus</span>跨平台<strong>仿微信/QQ电脑端</strong>聊天Exe程序。<span style="background-color: rgba(204, 255, 204, 1)">封装electron多窗口管理、自定义系统导航栏</span>。实现<strong>聊天、通讯录、收藏、朋友圈/短视频、我的</strong>等模块。</span></p>
<p><img alt="未标题-1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250913072029486-1534336236.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>使用技术</h3>
<ul>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">编辑器：VScode</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">技术框架：Electron38.0.0+Vite7.1.2+Vue3.5.18+vue-router4.5.1</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">UI组件库：element-plus^2.11.2</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">状态管理：pinia^3.0.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">存储服务：pinia-plugin-persistedstate^4.5.0</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">打包构建：electron-builder^24.13.3</span></li>
<li><span style="font-size: 12px">electron结合vite插件：vite-plugin-electron^0.29.0</span></li>
</ul>
<p><img alt="p1" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250913072548937-1676462517.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="p2" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250913072804156-1622991910.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>项目结构框架</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">vue3-electronchat桌面端聊天项目采用最新版&nbsp;<span class="cnblogs_code">vite7+electron38</span>&nbsp;搭建项目模板。</span></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20250911234347782" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250913073040268-917419848.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<blockquote>
<h4><em>Electron38-ViteChat聊天项目已经更新到我的原创作品集，感谢支持！</em></h4>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px"><a href="https://mall.bilibili.com/neul-next/detailuniversal/detail.html?isMerchant=1&amp;page=detailuniversal_detail&amp;saleType=10&amp;itemsId=13136393&amp;loadingShow=1&amp;noTitleBar=1&amp;msource=merchant_share" target="_blank" rel="noopener nofollow">基于Electron38+Vue3+ElementPlus仿微信客户端聊天系统</a></span></p>
</blockquote>
<p><img alt="p4" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250913073505104-1483835061.gif" class="lazyload"></p>
<h3>通用布局模板</h3>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">项目整体分为<strong>左侧菜单栏+侧边栏+右侧内容区(自定义导航条)</strong>等模块。</span></p>
<p><img alt="360截图20250911233614102" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250913073744421-1992270846.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250913073839199-108741287.png" class="lazyload"></p>

<h3>Electron主进程/预加载文件配置</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250913074947075-1129199514.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * electron主进程配置
 * @author andy
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

import { app, BrowserWindow } from </span>'electron'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

import { WindowManager } from </span>'../src/windows/index.js'

<span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 忽略安全警告提示 Electron Security Warning (Insecure Content-Security-Policy)</span>
process.env['ELECTRON_DISABLE_SECURITY_WARNINGS'] = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

const createWindow </span>= () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  let win </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> WindowManager()
  win.create({isMajor: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">})
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 系统托盘管理</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  win.trayManager()
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 监听ipcMain事件</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">  win.ipcManager()
}

app.whenReady().then(() </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  createWindow()

  app.on(</span>'activate', () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(BrowserWindow.getAllWindows().length === 0<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) createWindow()
  })
})

app.on(</span>'window-all-closed', () =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(process.platform !== 'darwin'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">) app.quit()
})</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * electron预加载文件配置
 * @author andy
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

import { contextBridge, ipcRenderer } from </span>'electron'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">

contextBridge.exposeInMainWorld(
  </span>'electron'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 通过 channel 向主进程发送异步消息。主进程使用 ipcMain.on() 监听 channel</span>
    send: (channel, args) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      ipcRenderer.send(channel, args)
    },

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 通过 channel 向主进程发送消息，并异步等待结果。主进程应该使用 ipcMain.handle() 监听 channel</span>
    invoke: (channel, args) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span> <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">new</span> Promise(resolve =&gt; ipcRenderer.invoke(channel, args).then(data =&gt; resolve(data)).<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">catch</span>(e =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> console.log(e)))
    },

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 监听 channel 事件</span>
    on: (channel, func) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      console.log(</span>'receive event'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
      ipcRenderer.on(channel, (event, ...args) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func(event, ...args))
    },

    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 一次性监听事件</span>
    once: (channel, func) =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      ipcRenderer.once(channel, (event, ...args) </span>=&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> func(event, ...args))
    },

    setTitle: (title) </span>=&gt; ipcRenderer.send('win-setTitle'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, title)
  }
)</span></pre>
</div>

<h3>Electron+Vite7封装新开多窗口</h3>
<p><img alt="image" loading="lazy" data-src="https://img2024.cnblogs.com/blog/1289798/202509/1289798-20250913080428480-2106586995.png" class="lazyload"></p>
<p><span style="font-size: 12px">项目支持同时打开多个窗口，调用封装函数即可快速创建一个新窗口。</span></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">/*</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*
 * 创建新窗口
 * @param {object} args 窗口配置参数 {url: '/about', width: 500, height: 300, ...}
 </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">*/</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
export </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">function</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> winCreate(args) {
  window.electron.send(</span>'win-create'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">, args)
}</span></pre>
</div>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 登录窗口</span>

    url: </span>'/login'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

    maximizable: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
    alwaysOnTop: </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">true</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
  })

<p><strong>窗口参数配置</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 自定义窗口参数</span>
const windowOptions =<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 窗口唯一标识id</span>
  id: <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,
  </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 窗口标题</span>
  title: 'Electron-ViteChat'<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">,

<p><strong>开启/关闭托盘图标闪烁</strong></p>
<div class="cnblogs_code">
<pre><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)">//</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 128, 0, 1)"> 开启/关闭托盘闪烁</span>
<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">trayFlash(bool) {
  let flag </span>= <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">false</span>
  <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">(bool) {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.trayTimer) <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">return</span>
    <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.trayTimer = setInterval(() =&gt;<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.tray.setImage(flag ? <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.trayIcon : <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.trayEmpty)
      flag </span>= !<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">flag
    }, </span>500<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">)
  }</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">else</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)"> {
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">if</span>(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.trayTimer) {
      clearInterval(</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.trayTimer)
      </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.trayTimer = <span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">null</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">
    }
    </span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span>.tray.setImage(<span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 255, 1)">this</span><span style="color: rgba(0, 0, 0, 1)">.trayIcon)
  }
}</span></pre>
